name: Bilinski's Organic Mild Italian Chicken Sausage (Skinless)
whyItWorks: Crafted without any casing (100% skinless) from organic skinless chicken breast, water, sea salt, and sweet fennel seed. Contains under 3g fat per link, zero nitrates/nitrites, and zero tough casing to choke strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat in a skillet with 1 tbsp water for 4 minutes until warm.
